title: The Crow and the Snake | Bedtime Story for Kids | زاغ و مار
description:
The Crow and the Snake: an animated bedtime story for kids from Kalila & Dimna, the ancient book of Persian fables. If a giant snake kept stealing your eggs, and you were just a tiny crow, how would you stop him?

قصه‌ی «زاغ و مار» از کلیله و دمنه، به زبان انگلیسی با انیمیشن و موسیقی سنتور؛ برای بچه‌های ایرانی در سراسر دنیا و همه‌ی بچه‌هایی که قصه دوست دارند.

Two crows build a cozy nest high in a tall tree, with three little eggs inside. But a big, greedy snake lives at the bottom of the tree, and every spring he creeps up for the eggs. The crows are too small to fight him... so they ask a wise old jackal, who has a very clever plan with a shiny necklace from the king's garden. Kalila and Dimna, our two jackal storytellers, tell you how it ends. (Nobody gets hurt: the snake just has to leave for good!)

Moral of the story: Cleverness beats a bully. Use your head, not your beak!
Persian word of the day: مار (maar) = snake.

ABOUT KALILA & DIMNA
Kalila & Dimna is a book of animal fables that began as the ancient Indian Panchatantra. It was translated into Middle Persian, then into Arabic by Ibn al-Muqaffa, and later into Persian, becoming one of the most widely translated story collections in the world.

This is an original animated adaptation of a public-domain classic. The script, animation, character voices and santur music were all made for this channel, to share the wisdom of Persian storytelling with children everywhere.
